announcement.note: (Monday; WotC said so in the Oct 12, 2026 announcement)

estimates.why: P(act) ~50%: WotC's Oct 12 'very likely ... very hard look at the Eldrazi package' (~60%), +10 for the Eldrazi family at ~19% on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp still #1 at 11.8%) and Broodscale Bloodchief #1 on MTGTop8 (12% of 521 decks) and S-tier on Spellslinger (79 top 8s in 30 days, best conversion in the format), -20 for organic correction (Spellslinger: mono-green Broodscale share down from 11.0% to 4.8%, Broodscale Bloodchief 7.0% vs Rakdos Delirium 6.8%; recent Challenges and the Nov 20 League went to other decks, with Broodscale 2nd in that League; effective archetypes ~30; no Modern RC until April 2027, so no season to protect; no new WotC wording as of Nov 22). Goldfish and Spellslinger still disagree on how big the deck is, so this is not averaged. x P(Command picked) ~30%: Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief or Emrakul are the narrower enablers and the most upvoted Reddit take is 'just ban broodscale or blade'; the Command is a flexible 4-of in 19% of all Modern decks (#18 staple, also in Tron and Trudge decks), which WotC avoids hitting.
#38 Legacy staple in 12% of decks; WotC called Legacy Eldrazi proactive and fair. No ban pressure.
Not a Vintage restriction candidate; in Commander it is in 0.78% of EDHREC decks and not on the Game Changers list (Scryfall: 53 Game Changers, Command not among them).

summary: WotC's Oct 12 update warned it is 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package' if Eldrazi keeps sitting on top, and named Kozilek's Command as a bridge to Emrakul in Broodscale Combo. As of Nov 22 there is no new WotC word; the deck is still #1 on MTGGoldfish (Eldrazi Ramp 11.8%) and MTGTop8 (Broodscale Bloodchief 12%), but its share keeps slipping and recent events went to other decks, so a Nov 30 hit on the archetype is about a coin flip. If WotC acts, Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief or Emrakul is the likelier pick; the Command is a real but secondary target.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (last 2 weeks)
sources.takeaway: 521 decks (last 2 weeks): Broodscale Bloodchief #1 at 12%, Rakdos Aggro 9%, UW Control 9%, Affinity 6%.

sources.title: Modern Metagame (full)
sources.takeaway: Eldrazi Ramp #1 at 11.8% (down from 12.0%); Eldrazi-family decks ~19% combined (Eldrazi Tron 3.5%, Eldrazi 2.5%, Broodscale 0.8%+0.2%, Mono-Green Eldrazi 0.3%).

sources.title: Modern Format Staples
sources.takeaway: Kozilek's Command #18 staple, 19% of decks; Sowing Mycospawn #30 (16%), Emrakul #34 (15%); Blade of the Bloodchief and Basking Broodscale fell out of the top 50.

sources.title: Legacy Format Staples
sources.takeaway: #38 Legacy staple, 12% of decks: no Legacy ban pressure.

sources.title: r/ModernMagic: "Urza's Saga as a ban candidate"
sources.takeaway: 'Broodscale is the front runner for bans'; others in the thread float K-Command, Saga, Temple or Emrakul as indirect hits.

sources.title: Modern Challenge 32 (Nov 20)
sources.takeaway: 63 players, won by Amulet Titan; one Broodscale Bloodchief in the top 8, at 3-4th.

sources.title: MTGO Modern League (Nov 20)
sources.takeaway: Won by Dimir Control; Broodscale Bloodchief finished 2nd, the only Eldrazi deck in the top 8.

sources.title: r/ModernMagic: "Urza's Saga as a ban candidate" (top comment)
sources.takeaway: Most upvoted take (+22): 'just ban broodscale or blade and be done with it' rather than weakening many decks.

sources.title: Kozilek's Command
sources.takeaway: ~82K decks, 0.78% inclusion, not a Game Changer: no Commander ban pressure.

sources.title: Banned and Restricted Announcement - October 12, 2026
sources.takeaway: No Modern changes; 'very likely that we take a very hard look at the Eldrazi package'; Command named as a bridge to Emrakul; next B&R Nov 30.
